name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. Where are we even going this early in the morning?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wasn't really told the details either」

name: Synn
message: 「Professor Sengenin just told me to come to Finis Tower...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I really don't think he's a bad person」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sheesh... You trust people way too easily」

name: Paqy
message: 「You sure we don't gotta let the others know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even Melilot is on guard, so getting them involved might be dangerous...」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, this is just me being selfish」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Well, if you're fine with it, Demon Lord, then whatever」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, him not even showing up himself makes it even fishier...」

name: Synn
message: 「If I remember right, there's supposed to be someone acting as a guide...」

name: Melphas
message: 「It has been quite some time, my lovely President」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... that you're the guide, Melphas?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Soltia asked me to show you around, my dear President」

name: Melphas
message: 「When a request comes from such a lovely lady, how could I possibly refuse?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yes. It seems that is the name she goes by here.」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am not privy to the finer details myself.」

name: Melphas
message: 「I was simply instructed to guide you, the Chairman, to the land of Nive in the Demon World.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then could it be that Melilot is a demon...」

name: Paqy
message: 「And on top of that, she's from that Nive Clan...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... Now this whole thing's starting to get a little interesting.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Well then, shall we be off at once?」

name: Melphas
message: 「There is a transfer gate to the Demon World on the upper floors of the tower.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the heck, that shut-in sure came prepared.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright, let's get going right away, Lord Synn!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You know better than anyone that not all demons are bad guys, right, Lord Synn?」
I don't know what Melilot is thinking, though...
That's something I can just go see and find out for myself!
Guided by Melphas, we climb Finis Tower.
Beyond the teleportation gate--aiming for the Demon World, where Melilot awaits...
The deeper we advance into the gate, the heavier the pressure of magical power weighs down on my entire body.
Even so, I can't afford to stop now.
No matter what, I have to reach the Demon World...!

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Been a while since I was in the Demon World」
At a glance, it's not as if there's nothing here.
Even so, is it only because of my own preconceptions that this place feels somehow empty?

name: Paqy
message: 「Hm? You're looking pale, Master Synn. You alright?」
So surely, the way my body aches and my breathing feels heavy must all just be my imagination.

name: Synn
message: 「Has the Demon World always been like this?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ever since the previous Demon Lord's time... no, since the very first Demon Lord, the Demon World's always been a desolate place」

name: Melphas
message: 「Word has it that the Land of Nibe is even more remote than here, however」

name: Melphas
message: 「I have heard they are an eccentric clan that despises contact with outsiders」

name: Melphas
message: 「Well, the real question is how many maidens I can nurture love with there, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Since way back, they've been the folks observing phenomena tied to the Re-Crea and coming up with countermeasures」

name: Paqy
message: 「What really matters is whether their tits are on par with Ria's, ya know」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey, don't get mad over just that……」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, it's not that, I'm fine……」

name: Melphas
message: 「Over there lies the settlement where the Nive Clan resides」

name: Paqy
message: 「First time I've ever come out this far……」
Though traces of culture can be seen, it is an even more desolate place than anywhere before.
How should I put it…… there's no sense of liveliness at all.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I don't know what that Soltia chick is thinking, but……」

name: Paqy
message: 「For now, let's look for the shut-in」

name: Melphas
message: 「If I may be so bold, I don't believe that will be necessary」

name: Melphas
message: 「From the moment we set foot here, we are the utmost outsiders. We stand out terribly」

name: Melphas
message: 「If it were the ladies taking notice of us, I would certainly welcome it, however……」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean even if we sit tight, they'll get suspicious and show their faces on their own」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, would it really be that easy……」
Amidst the unfamiliar scenery stands a familiar face.
So it really was true that she came to the Demon World...

name: Synn
message: 「I just wanted to know about you, Melilot-san, no matter what...」

name: Synn
message: 「I just wanted to help you, Melilot-san...」

name: Synn
message: 「When I thought about what I could do...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Knowing you, Sakura-kun, you acted out of pure goodwill, didn't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「While I am grateful, I have no intention of blaming you for those feelings」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, I also bear responsibility for not telling you anything, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「After all, we are both equally at fault this time」

name: Melilot
message: 「Perhaps... I must take action as well...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let me tell you about my mission」

name: Melilot
message: 「Since ancient times, our clan, living here in the land of Nibe, has observed Re-Crea and preserved its records」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is, of course, to find a way to save the world from Re-Crea」

name: Melilot
message: 「Originally, being a race among the Demons possessing spiritual qualities close to angels, we likely had a strong sense of mission as well」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, I am now the only one left to carry on that mission」

name: Melilot
message: 「I suppose none of the others could bear the crushing weight of an endless responsibility」

name: Melilot
message: 「If I hadn't met Helena and the others in the Human World...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even I, who was raised with great care as a precious successor, might have followed the exact same path」

name: Melilot
message: 「Especially for someone like me, who only knew the limited world inside the tower...」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, perhaps that is just idle rambling on my part」

name: Melilot
message: 「In any case, that is how I took on the duty of observation, with the previous Re-Crea as my very first assignment」

name: Melilot
message: 「I had already been working with past data at Finis Tower before then, so it wasn't particularly difficult」

name: Melilot
message: 「That data has since been transferred to the library's archives, as well」

name: Melilot
message: 「Finis Tower, which served as the Re-Crea observation facility, had been growing quite dilapidated, so it was only natural」

name: Melilot
message: 「That happened right around the time I took up my post as the academy's librarian」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heaven, the Demon World, and the Human World. The tower, located at the boundary of each, was flawless as an observation facility, however...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Having spent my childhood there, it is also a place where I hold very few fond memories」

name: Melilot
message: 「And that brings us to the present, arriving at your question, Sakura-kun, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The reason I have been visiting this land regularly is to store the records of Re-Crea」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even though our population has dwindled to the extreme, our clan's purpose has not been lost」

name: Melilot
message: 「Backups of the data gathered through observation are stored here, to be put to use by future generations」

name: Melilot
message: 「Until that time, uncertain of when it may even come, when the Re-Crea is completely resolved...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I believe that covers the gist of things regarding myself and the clan of the land of Nibe, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「……Up until now, I thought you were just an ordinary librarian, Melilot-san」

name: Synn
message: 「I never even imagined you had such a heavy mission...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Still, there's no need for you to worry about it, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「To be honest, I can't bring myself to like my clan's stubborn ways」

name: Melilot
message: 「They even tried to separate Helena from me once, claiming she was a hindrance to my mission」
Could she be talking about the attempted confinement incident I heard about from Helena-san earlier?

name: Melilot
message: 「I also have friends like Helena and Riesling」

name: Melilot
message: 「And I even have you watching out for me, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「...That alone is enough to keep me going」

name: Melilot
message: 「By the way, how did you make it to the Demon World, Sakura-kun?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Did you find the tower's gate on your own?」

name: Melphas
message: 「O, my fair librarian for whom I have so achingly pined, at last fate has granted our meeting!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I certainly never wished for it, though」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh! Even that ice-cold retort is bewitching and eloquent!」

name: Melphas
message: 「It is as though my heart has been bound tightly by the thorns you hold...」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, Melilot-san. I don't think he's that bad of a person, so」

name: Melphas
message: 「Ah! Caught between the love of maidens, whatever am I to do...!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yes. By Soltia, who, just like you and me, is called one of the Seven Demon Generals」

name: Melilot
message: 「...As for me, please do not worry」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will never become an enemy to you and the others, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「Did you meet her? Soltia, before coming here?」

name: Synn
message: 「She told me that if I went to the Demon World, I could be of help to you, Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let us go home, Sakura-kun. My business here is finished」
My arm is pulled with a forcefulness completely unlike the usual Melilot-san.
All at once, my knees give out and strike the ground.

name: Melilot
message: 「It's only natural for a body unaccustomed to the Demon World」

name: Melilot
message: 「Come now, let's hurry back to the Human World」
Taking Melilot-san's hand, I stand back up.
The warmth radiating from it helps me feel somewhat better.
Truth be told, the more I walked, the worse I felt
Still, I couldn't afford to collapse and make Melilot-san worry
The gate is just a little further......
And yet, my willpower can't hold out.
My body refuses to move the way I want it to.

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems you've exhausted quite a bit of your stamina......」

name: Melilot
message: 「You don't have to force yourself to speak.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And I don't think of you as a bother, either.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I don't think it was a mistake that you came chasing after me, Sakura-kun.」
Someone's voice echoes inside my head.
A whisper reverberates deep within my mind.
This voice, yes... It's that person's...!
Everything and anything is dyed the color of darkness.
What just swept her aside was my own power.
The magic overflowing from the depths of my body overwrites my will, thrashing and raging wildly.
If I don't stop it, I'll hurt Melilot-san...

name: Paqy
message: 「Damn it... To think you'd awaken like this...!」
So this is the Demon Lord's power.
This immense power beyond my control is the proof of the Demon Lord...

name: Melilot
message: 「I see, so that's how it is...」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Looks like all our secrets are out in the open now.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. However, this is no time to rejoice, nor to despair.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon Lord! Can't you hear our voices?!」
My body won't listen to me.
Dominating both fear and confusion, it rages wildly until everything is utterly destroyed.
Unerringly, the iron hammer of darkness bares its fangs at Melilot-san.
Yet, where the blow pierced, no shadow remained...

name: Melphas
message: 「What on earth happened to the President...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「An unintended awakening as the Demon Lord, and his magic running wild...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I can't help thinking this whole situation was set up」
A pitch-black urge craving destruction and slaughter swells up inside me.
Neither this power, nor these deeds, nor the sight before my eyes feels like my own.
Can I no longer stop myself...?!

name: Melphas
message: 「At this rate, will we not be in grave danger?」

name: Melphas
message: 「There is a limit to how far we can run, and against that magical power, even for us...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I know that if we don't stop Sakura-kun, we'll be killed...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I know that I have to defeat Sakura-kun...!」
If the alternative is hurting Melilot-san, I don't care!
I don't want to see Melilot-san look pained anymore!

name: Melilot
message: 「To drive back Re-Crea, I have staked my entire life...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even with this Re-Crea, I'm confident we can make it through without relying on the Demon Lord's power...」

name: Melilot
message: 「So stopping you here, Sakura-kun, is nothing at all...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes... even hurting you, Sakura-kun, is nothing at all...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...is supposed to be nothing at all, yet...!」
If this power is inside of me, then even for just a second!
I never wanted any of this!!
Now, while there's still time, hurry!
I don't care what happens to me!
I can't hold it back any longer...!
A blow that feels like it's gouging out the core of my soul pierces through me and slams me down.
A searing heat engulfs my entire body, while at the same time, a freezing chill rears its head and brings on shivers.
The fear, the indignation, and the shock that had been inside me.
I threw it all up together.

name: Melilot
message: 「Everything is going to be alright now……」
Held in Melilot-san's arms, my ragged breathing gradually calms down.
My consciousness is hazy, drifting without focus.
「In the end, the Demon Lord's power without a will behind it amounts to only this much……」

name: Melilot
message: 「With your strength, it should have been possible to eliminate him as well……」

name: Virus
message: 「Nibe. It is not too late, even now」

name: Virus
message: 「Train the Demon King. And guide him properly into what he is meant to be」

name: Virus
message: 「What I desire is one thing alone」

name: Virus
message: 「Only a heated, blood-stirring battle against the strong!」

name: Virus
message: 「However, if he is deceived by petty tricksters and loses sight of himself, it is not even worth discussing」

name: Virus
message: 「Show me the strength I seek, in both mind and body!」

name: Melilot
message: 「And if I refuse…… you'll slaughter us all?」

name: Virus
message: 「Sorry, but I have no interest in the weak」

name: Virus
message: 「To achieve your own goals as well, the power of a mighty Demon King will surely prove useful」

name: Virus
message: 「It will not merely satisfy me, you know」

name: Virus
message: 「If mutual benefit is to be gained, there could be no folly greater than refusing this」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will have Sakura become a Demon King beyond reproach」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, do not forget that the one left crying in regret will be you」

name: Melilot
message: 「First, let's go back and get you some rest」

name: Melilot
message: 「We can think about things after that」
As Melilot-san gently stroked my head.
My consciousness sank into a deep darkness... .
